name: Harukaze Inori
source:
Formed Sub-Couple 02 with [url=/c128230]Kanda Kousei[/url].

[url=/c125792]Meguri[/url]'s younger sister and the president of the student council. The unattainable high class flower with beauty and brains.
However, she has strong prejudices against men and has always been against the idea of a co-educational school.
Has a very different personality from her older sister's, and is often told that they look nothing alike.
Despite her pure and grateful attitude, she has short stature, so [url=/c125793]Tokoyo[/url] always pats her on the head and treats her as if she were the younger one.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.asa-pro.com/koibana/character/subcouples.html]official website[/url]]
